decommission.name: ACME
decommission.note: POLNEW and UNDWRT pass the 29/30-character MQ names as QUEUE(); CICS uses the first 4 characters, so both write TD queue ACME (Q-13). The DCT/CSD entry and its MQ bridge live in the CICS region, outside this repository.

decommission.name: ACME.PAS.UNDERWRITING.REQUEST
decommission.note: I-4. Fed by the bridge sink until the underwriting work queue reads pas.underwriting.requested.

decommission.name: ACME.PAS.UNDERWRITING.DECISION
decommission.note: I-5. Fed by the bridge sink until underwriting referrals read pas.underwriting.decided.

decommission.name: ENDORSEMENT-AUDIT
decommission.note: Temporary storage, no reader in the repository; the endorsement is recorded in PASAPP.POLICY_CHANGE_AUDIT (V60) and pas.policy.endorsed.

decommission.name: FileNet document trigger queue (name pending FU-06)
decommission.note: I-6. The queue FileNet listens on is not in the repository; the sink config takes it from PAS_FILENET_TRIGGER_QUEUE.

decommission.name: Broker Portal linked server to DB2 (ODBC, read-only)
decommission.note: I-3. Definition and queries pending FU-18.

decommission.name: SELECT grants on ACMEINS for the Broker Portal ODBC user
decommission.replaced_by: OAuth client with pas.policy.read and an entitlement (SEC-01)

decommission.name: pas-mq-sink-* and pas.bridge.*
decommission.note: INT-01 is temporary; retired last, after D1-D5.
decommission.replaced_by: native consumers of the domain events

gates.description: Consumer inventory complete: every reader of TD queue ACME, both MQ queues, the FileNet trigger queue (FU-06) and the Broker Portal linked server (FU-18) identified with an owner
gates.owner: MQ admins + ECM + Broker Portal team

gates.description: Test environment: FileNet generates documents for a new, a renewed and an endorsed policy from the bridge (sink) or from the events directly; MessagingBridgeIT is the automated precondition
Underwriting work queue and referral consumers read pas.underwriting.requested / decided (or the bridged queues) and process them in a test environment
Broker Portal runs on the inquiry API in production with its DB2 linked server disabled for 30 days without errors (PolicyInquiryApiIT covers the API side)
CICS PNEW, PUWR, PRWL and PEND switched to NEW (ADR C-4..C-7) and TD queue ACME / both MQ queues receive no messages from CICS for 30 days
Sign-offs: Security, Data governance, ECM, Underwriting ops, Broker Portal team, Platform, ARB
Rollback window closed: one release cycle with the queues disabled (not deleted) and no rollback request

steps.description: Disable (PUT(DISABLED)) ACME.PAS.UNDERWRITING.REQUEST/DECISION and the FileNet trigger queue; keep the definitions for G7 (MQ admins, outside this repository)
Remove the TD queue ACME and the TS queue use from the CICS CSD with the CICS programs' retirement (AB-530)
Drop the Broker Portal linked server and revoke its DB2 grants (D6, D7)
Delete the three pas-mq-sink connectors and the pas.bridge.* topics; set PAS_BRIDGE_ENABLED=false everywhere
After G7, delete the MQ queue definitions (D2, D3, D5)
Open a PR that removes the bridge package and pas/deploy/messaging; the legacy trees are retired by AB-530, never here
